items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: Well, did Louis sit in with your band before he joined the band? ... Louie, when he sat in like that. He played Ole Miss.

ctx.x: Hey-oh. Fair off and go, huh? When do you first remember seeing Louis Armstrong? On a parade on a Labor Day. He was an extra band.
The kid band. I was a kid band.
